The earlier analysis flagged that the chat-inject-button anchor used for STOP_BUTTON.within is absent when mid-turn injection is off. The implementation commit 92265334 dropped the positional nth pick, so this appears resolved. The reviewer should confirm it.

Case text says to click Stop while 'thinking'. The implementation clicks at first Stop visibility, either 'Waking the agent…' or 'Thinking', and relies on the step 4 assertions to prove the cancel happened. The AFS was amended to match.

STOP_BUTTON can only be resolved when mid-turn injection is enabled, because its anchor chat-inject-button is absent otherwise. Stop is the same button either way. A testid 'chat-stop-button' on the Stop BaseBtn would remove this coupling. It is a migrator hint and was not worked here.
